mexico.summary: Visa-free for tourism for up to 180 days.
notes: The immigration officer determines your permitted stay; 180 days is not guaranteed.
mexico.passport: Valid for the duration of your stay.

japan.summary: Visa-free for tourism for up to 90 days.
japan.passport: Valid for the duration of your stay.

portugal.summary: Visa-free for tourism for up to 90 days in any 180-day period.
notes: The limit covers your combined stays across the Schengen area.
ETIAS applications are not yet open; check the latest requirements before travel.
portugal.passport: Valid for at least 3 months after leaving the Schengen area.

italy.summary: Visa-free for tourism for up to 90 days in any 180-day period.
notes: The limit covers your combined stays across the Schengen area.
ETIAS applications are not yet open; check the latest requirements before travel.
italy.passport: Valid for at least 3 months after leaving the Schengen area.

notes: Check the permitted length of stay in the official guidance or with Argentine authorities.
argentina.passport: Valid for the duration of your stay.

thailand.summary: Visa-free for tourism for up to 30 days.
notes: Complete the Thailand Digital Arrival Card before arrival.
thailand.passport: Valid for at least 6 months upon entry.

notes: An eVisa before travel or a 30-day visa on arrival is available to Canadian passport holders.
Different conditions apply to some Sinai-only visits; see official guidance.
egypt.passport: Valid for at least 6 months after your expected departure from Egypt.

new-zealand.summary: Visa-free for tourism for up to 90 days; NZeTA required.
notes: Obtain your NZeTA before travel. The tourism levy and a New Zealand Traveller Declaration also apply.
new-zealand.passport: Valid for at least 3 months after your expected departure from New Zealand.

united-states.summary: Visa-free tourism is generally permitted for up to 6 months.
notes: The border officer determines admission and your permitted stay. Some travellers face exceptions.
united-states.passport: For air travel, a Canadian passport must be valid for the duration of your stay.

notes: Eligible regular Canadian passport holders can apply for an eVisa for up to 90 days; entry-point and visa conditions apply.
vietnam.passport: Valid for at least 6 months beyond your expected departure from Vietnam.

colombia.summary: Visa-free for tourism for up to 90 days.
notes: Complete the Check-Mig immigration form. An entry fee applies to many Canadian visitors; exemptions exist.
colombia.passport: Valid for the duration of your stay.

morocco.summary: Visa-free for tourism for stays of less than 90 days.
morocco.passport: Valid for at least 6 months beyond your expected departure from Morocco.

spain.summary: Visa-free tourism for up to 90 days within any 180-day period in the Schengen area.
notes: The 90-day allowance is shared across Schengen countries.
spain.passport: Valid for at least 3 months after your planned departure from the Schengen area.

greece.summary: Visa-free tourism for up to 90 days within any 180-day period in the Schengen area.
notes: The 90-day allowance is shared across Schengen countries.
greece.passport: Valid for at least 3 months after your planned departure from the Schengen area.

costa-rica.summary: Tourist visa not required for stays of up to 180 days.
notes: The immigration officer decides your permitted stay. Carry a return or onward ticket and evidence of sufficient funds.
costa-rica.passport: Valid for the duration of your stay.

indonesia.summary: Tourist visa required. Canadians may obtain one in advance or on arrival at eligible entry points.
notes: A return or onward ticket is required. Use official immigration channels to arrange your visa.
indonesia.passport: Valid for at least 6 months after entry, with at least one blank page.

france.summary: Visa-free for tourism for up to 90 days in any 180-day period.
notes: The limit covers your combined stays across the Schengen area.
ETIAS applications are not yet open; check the latest requirements before travel.
france.passport: Valid for at least 3 months after leaving the Schengen area.

united-kingdom.summary: ETA required for visa-free tourism for up to 6 months.
notes: Apply for an Electronic Travel Authorisation before travel and use the passport linked to it.
British or Irish dual citizens cannot apply for an ETA; check the official passport requirements.
united-kingdom.passport: Valid for the duration of your stay.

turkey.summary: Visa-free for tourism for up to 90 days in a 180-day period.
notes: Leave Türkiye for at least 90 days before a subsequent 90-day visa-exempt stay.
turkey.passport: Valid for at least 150 days from entry, with room for entry and exit stamps.

peru.summary: Visa-free for tourism for stays of less than 90 days per 365-day period.
notes: Check your authorized stay on your digital entry record when arriving by air; obtain an entry stamp when arriving by land.
peru.passport: Valid for at least 6 months after arrival.

notes: Canadian passport holders can apply for an eVisa.
For stays longer than 90 days, obtain an extension before your authorized stay expires.
brazil.passport: Valid for the duration of your stay.

south-africa.summary: Visa-free for tourism for up to 90 days.
notes: The immigration officer determines your permitted stay; a full 90 days is not automatic.
south-africa.passport: Valid for at least 30 days after departure, with at least 2 empty visa pages.

south-korea.summary: Visa-free for tourism for up to 180 days.
notes: Canadians are exempt from K-ETA until December 31, 2026; verify requirements for later travel.
Submit the required entry declaration online up to 3 days before arrival or on paper on arrival.
south-korea.passport: Valid beyond your expected departure date.

australia.summary: Electronic Travel Authority (ETA) required for short tourist visits.
notes: Obtain an ETA before travel and use the passport linked to it.
Canada’s guidance lists tourist stays of up to 90 days; follow the stay conditions on your ETA.
australia.passport: Valid on the day of entry.
